name: Polar Night Energy sand batteries: Kankaanpaeae (Vatajankoski) and Pornainen, Finland
description: Kankaanpaeae: world's first commercial sand battery, 100 kW heating power / 8 MWh, in commercial use since mid-2022; Pornainen: 1 MW / 100 MWh, world's largest, in operation 2025

sources.note: Evertiq, 1 Jul 2025 (Pornainen 1 MW / 100 MWh, ten times the first unit); Proactive Investors, 5 Jul 2022 (Kankaanpaeae 100 kW / 8 MWh commercial sale); read 2026-10-28
